instruction: When I read code snippets on technical websites, I prefer Consolas font over the default monospace. Could you set Chrome's fixed-width font to Consolas?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the fixed-width (monospace) font family to Consolas. The evaluator checks if the fixed_font_family in Chrome preferences matches 'Consolas' (case-insensitive). This font is used for displaying code, preformatted text, and other monospaced content.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts fixed-width font from Chrome preferences at webkit.webprefs.fonts.fixed.Zyyy path
Metric implements appropriate case-insensitive comparison for font name matching
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the single instruction requirement (set fixed-width font to Consolas)
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure settings persistence and enable verification
Cross-platform support handles Windows, macOS, and Linux preference file paths correctly
Expected value 'Consolas' semantically matches the instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: getter extracts font name, metric compares exact value with case-insensitive logic
Error handling returns reasonable default value without crashing
